verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents trigger-driven flows that run on activation once published. Its agents are briefed in plain language and "handle the work as it arrives," and durable execution lets interrupted runs resume from checkpoints, so the core of autonomous background automation is directly delivered. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of recurring schedule/cron triggers (the 'every morning' example is only a sample prompt for drafting an agent, not a documented schedule capability), and independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended background runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: You write down the job in plain language, give it access to the apps it needs, and it handles the work as it arrives.
Actions come after the trigger and control what occurs when the flow is activated, like running code or communicating with other services.
Interrupted runs resume from their last checkpoint instead of starting over
It decides the steps and carries them out.
